comparison.objective: Place an emergency call through a locked phone’s safe UI route; candidate commissions a mechanical damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR performs precise touchscreen swipes and taps while avoiding passcode entry. Candidate performs contact-rich tool alignment, torque, collar manipulation, and fixture actuation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires a clean 911 call maintained for 3 s; any passcode attempt fails. Candidate requires two bounded physical stopping cycles without damage or drift. PR has no separate spec.
comparison.reason: Touchscreen procedural interaction is unrelated to mechanical adjustment and force-controlled dynamic testing.
